channel.title: Pier & Point · Bayfront Park
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Bayfront Park (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Bayfront Park: The 2026-09-24 row summary says the Commission was asked to accept "completed improvements". Port Commission agenda, item 11E: "Request Port Commission acceptance of Mission Bay Park improvements for Bayfront Park". The word completed is not in it, and the record's open questions say no physical-completion date was found. The earlier row is left as written.

item.title: Correction · Bayfront Park: Bayfront Park lies between Chase Center and the Bay, was developed by Mission Bay Development Group with OCII, and is to be owned and maintained by the Port. The Port's pre-event notice named 16th Street Plaza as the ceremony location; the City's release names no venue.

item.title: Correction · Bayfront Park: The summary said roughly 5.5 acres; the cited sources say 5.4 acres (SF.gov) or over five acres (the Port), so it now says 5.4. It said benches and sculptures were made from reclaimed Bay Bridge steel; SF.gov says shade structures and other site furnishings. The opening milestone no longer names '16th Street Plaza', which the release does not. The map notes no longer say the OpenStreetMap shape was confirmed by a Port operator tag and Wikidata id (it has only operator:wikidata for the Port's item) and now list its actual tags; the contrast with Community Facilities District parks was removed, and the P-number note no longer calls Lotus Water the landscape architect. The claim that the park occupies plan parcels P21 and P22 is not stated by any cited source and remains unconfirmed pending a check against the Design Controls Plan map. The Wikimedia aerial's credit names only the Commons username Firstcultural.

item.title: Under construction · Bayfront Park: Groundbreaking ceremony for Bayfront Park, with Mayor London Breed, Supervisor Matt Dorsey and the Golden State Warriors, marking the start of construction ($19.1 million budget, OCII/FOCIL-MB LLC). The Mayor's release dated August 3, 2022 says she "today joined Supervisor Matt Dorsey, the Golden State Warriors and other City and community leaders to celebrate the start of construction for Bayfront Park" (Aug 3, 2022)
